review_surface: Aseprite-composited 1600x900 FancyMenu approximation using the actual background, title and button material
notes: The title remains the dominant silhouette without covering the primary village path, moon or foreground witch
The right-side button column occupies the darker waterfall and cliff region and retains deliberate cool contrast against the warm title
The original background and user-approved title are unretouched apart from FancyMenu scaling
Runtime text labels and hover states are not represented in this static composition
